EDITORIAL - The Battle is no Longer Just About Better AI
Imagine asking an AI assistant to find the best deal on groceries. It compares products, remembers your preferences, selects a basket and completes the purchase.
Meanwhile, Meta’s Muse and OpenAI’s Dots represent another shift: AI systems that remember context.
💡 KEY HIGHLIGHT
AI is moving beyond a race to build the most capable model.

THE GATEKEEPERS


Amazon blocks. Walmart opens the door.
Imagine a future in which you never open a retailer’s website. Instead, your AI agent compares prices across stores.
On October 21, 2026, Walmart announced its Agent Gateway, built to let approved AI agents connect.
💡 KEY HIGHLIGHT
The strategic question is not whether a company is open or closed.

While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat →

LOOKING AHEAD


From one AI race to many specialised markets
Technology markets often evolve from a period of broad experimentation into one where products become more distinct.
